init.title: ČEZ Dynamic Tariff options
init.description: Each schedule is a comma-separated list of `HH:MM=price change in %` items. The first item must start at `00:00`; adding or removing an item adds or removes a tariff band. Thresholds only classify modifiers as cheap or expensive and do not change the schedule.

data.include_holidays: Treat Czech public holidays as weekend/holiday

data_description.cheap_threshold: A band at or below this modifier is cheap. Default: -10 %.
data_description.super_cheap_threshold: A band at or below this modifier is super cheap. Default: -50 %.
data_description.expensive_threshold: A band at or above this modifier is expensive. Default: +10 %.
data_description.reset_schedules: Discard all custom times and price modifiers and restore the project defaults.
data_description.winter_workday_schedule: Full schedule, for example: 00:00=-10, 03:00=-50, 05:00=+25. The next start ends the previous band.
data_description.winter_offday_schedule: Full schedule, for example: 00:00=-10, 03:00=-50, 05:00=+10. The number of bands can be changed.
data_description.summer_workday_schedule: Full schedule, for example: 00:00=-10, 03:00=-50, 05:00=+25. The number of bands can be changed.
data_description.summer_offday_schedule: Full schedule, for example: 00:00=-10, 03:00=-50, 05:00=+10. The last band ends at midnight.
